purpose: Durable index of work that is still owed. Completion history belongs in COMPLETION-LEDGER-001; expectations belong in EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-001; only open/blocked/deferred obligations belong here.
rules: Every non-closed obligation has exactly one canonical owner_path.
An obligation may depend on another owner, but dependency does not transfer ownership.
A completed obligation is closed here and appended to the completion ledger with evidence; it is not erased from history.
A changed objective creates a supersession link rather than silently rewriting what the prior obligation meant.
Second Shift may execute only the subset explicitly delegated from an open obligation and revalidated against the live owner control head.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority, native-platform and publication boundaries remain explicit blocker classes.
